title: Two-Arm Ordinal Instrument Analysis Toolkit
description: Analysis code for controlled comparisons that use short ordinal instruments administered to practitioners. Covers equivalence testing against a declared margin, multiplicity control across instrument items, declared response integrity screening with a sensitivity family, and inference for clustered and partially paired samples. Includes the drivers, column map and run provenance for the lesson planning study of 2026.
